item.title: 'Hoppers,' Disney-Pixar's latest animated adventure, features beavers as animal superheroes
item.description: Beavers are the superstars of "Hoppers." The filmmakers regard them as the animal superheroes of the environment. They worked with scientists to learn all about beavers as they created a story about the importance of community.

item.title: Wayne Township passes ordinance to limit hours for door-to-door solicitations
item.description: Ordinance 13 of the code changes says no person shall be permitted to solicit, canvas, or peddle between 7 p.m. and 9 a.m.

item.title: Small plane hits homes in Phoenix, crashes nose-down next to backyard pool, injuring 3
item.description: A small plane struck two homes in Phoenix on Wednesday before crashing nose-down in a backyard, injuring the two people on board and a man in one of the homes, authorities said.

item.title: Malware attack impacting IT systems, phone lines in Passaic County, New Jersey
item.description: Officials in Passaic County say the malware attack is affecting their IT systems and impacting their phone lines.

item.title: Mayor Mamdani pushes childcare plan and praises new Siena Poll on raising taxes
item.description: A new Siena Poll found that 54% of state residents approve of higher city taxes on millionaires and major corporations compared to 29% who don't.

item.title: 19-year-old man fatally shot in the Bronx; police searching for suspects who fled on scooters
item.description: Officers found a 19-year-old man unconscious and unresponsive with a gunshot wound to the chest in the Belmont section of the Bronx.

item.title: Mother, daughter from Brooklyn scrambling to get home after being stranded in the Middle East
item.description: Miriam and Adina Steinberg have been sheltering at a safe room for multiple hours a day each day since Saturday when the U.S. and Israel launched their attack on Iran.

item.title: PATH train service in and out of Hoboken expected to resume Thursday morning after power issue
item.description: PATH train service in and out of Hoboken is expected to resume Thursday morning following a power issue on Wednesday night.

item.title: Judge rules companies entitled to refunds for Trump tariffs overturned by SCOTUS
item.description: In a defeat for the Trump administration, a federal judge in New York ruled Wednesday that companies that paid tariffs struck down last month by Supreme Court are due refunds.

item.title: Massive Logan Twp. explosion felt across Philadelphia region
item.description: The explosion rocked Savita Naturals, a commercial facility in Swedesboro that processes cocoa butter for the chocolate industry.
